name: 紅胸田雞

iucn.assessmentNote: IUCN全球無危；香港屬稀少過境及冬候鳥

illustrationTaxon: Zapornia fusca adult; sexes similar, with no sex-specific plumage claim

similarSpecies.distinction: 紅腳苦惡鳥上體橄欖褐、下體橄欖灰且喉淡白，沒有紅胸；腿紫紅、喙基黃綠。香港為罕見及不規則訪客／偶見留鳥。
小田雞體型較小，春羽灰色臉及下體、褐頰、上體具白斑、脅及尾下密集黑白橫斑，腿黃綠；與紅胸田雞的紅胸及深紅腿不同。

featureNotes: 短暗灰喙、橙褐額及深紅頰
成鳥喉、胸及上腹呈深紅色
暗色脅及尾下覆羽有稀疏、間隔較大的白橫斑
成鳥腿腳深紅；不把長趾誤標為另一物種特徵

sources.use: Full species account read: Hong Kong Category I scarce passage migrant and winter visitor in dense freshwater/brackish marsh; 21–23 cm; short dull-grey bill, orange-brown forehead, deep reddish cheek/throat/chest/upper belly, cold-brown upperparts/flanks, dark vent and undertail with irregular widely spaced white bars, deep-red legs; female usually paler with whiter throat and immatures duller. Breeding/range spans East and South Asia through Indochina to the Philippines/Indonesia and Sri Lanka; global IUCN LC, trend decreasing.

Full HKBWS Brown Crake account read: adult plain olive-brown above, olive-grey below, indistinct pale throat, deep pinkish-purple legs, yellow-green bill base; a rare/irregular Hong Kong visitor and occasional resident; global IUCN LC.

HKBWS Baillon's Crake account read: smaller 17–19 cm; spring adult greyish underparts/supercilium, brown cheek, warm-brown upperparts with irregular whitish marks, black-white barred lower flanks and denser undertail, yellowish-green legs; scarce spring/autumn passage migrant in Hong Kong; global IUCN LC.
